description: keeps selected top-level keys from one JSON object using only bounded caller-supplied values. Call when you need a bounded json object pick result before an agent hands structured data or a batch plan to a downstream tool with a stricter contract. Returns the bounded transformation or validation finding with counts, normalized values, and a versioned result contract for JSON Object Pick as versioned deterministic JSON. Limitation: Processes bounded caller-supplied data in memory only; it performs no file fetch, database write, code execution, or retention.

keys.description: Keys supplied to JSON Object Pick; used only for this bounded calculation and processed in memory without retention.

object.description: Object supplied to JSON Object Pick; used only for this bounded calculation and processed in memory without retention.

name: util_json_object_pick
